_comment: This file is a MMSegmentation configuration file containing only variable assignments and dictionary literals. It has no functions, classes, or callable APIs. It defines hyperparameters, model architecture, optimizer, dataset pipelines, and training settings for the Sapiens 0.3B segmentation model on the Goliath dataset at 1024x768 resolution.
review_sapiens_config: review the sapiens 0.3b segmentation model config for the goliath dataset at 1024x768 resolution
summarize_model_architecture: summarize the encoder-decoder model architecture with vision transformer backbone and vit head decoder
review_train_pipeline: review the training data augmentation pipeline including random resize, crop, rotate, and flip operations
review_optimizer_config: review the adamw optimizer with layer decay and gradient clipping configuration
review_dataset_config: review the goliath dataset configuration for training and validation dataloaders
